newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Austrlaia dlr slumps to 3-mth low on rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Austrlaia dlr slumps to 3-mth low on rate cut.

text.p: The Australian dollar slumped more than 3/4 cent in hectic morning trade after the Reserve Bank of Australia caught much of the market by surprise by cutting official cash rates 0.5 point to 5.5 percent.
By 9.40 am (2340 GMT) the dollar had dived to US$0.7680/85, its lowest level since mid-February, from US$0.7761/66 just ahead of the RBA's announcement.
It had alread fallen from US$0.7830/35 overnight on press reports the RBA was considering an easing following domestic wages data released on Thursday.
